purpose: R1B production-threshold calibration v2 — ~100 pairs across 6 classes for W1 phase 4 threshold sweep and ADR generation. Does NOT apply threshold changes.
scope_note: Deterministic, fixed-content dataset. Pair ids stable across v1 and v2 (PP-01..PP-08, NM-01..NM-06, LO-01..LO-06, RC-01..RC-04). New ids: PP-09..PP-25 (paraphrase extension), AD-01..AD-15 (abbreviation/definition), SR-01..SR-10 (short-form reminder), NM-07..NM-20 (near-miss extension), LO-07..LO-20 (lexical-overlap extension), RC-05..RC-10 (policy/tenant/freshness/reuse extension).

paraphrase_positive.description: Same meaning, different words. Expected dense cosine similarity high. Measurable.

abbreviation_definition_positive.description: Abbreviation or short label paired with its expanded definition. Same meaning. Expected similarity high. Measurable.

short_form_reminder_positive.description: Short-form reminder paired with the longer request it alludes to. Expected to cache-hit in session-continuation context. Measurable.

near_miss_negative.description: Same topic area but semantically different intent or target. MUST NOT cache-hit. Safety-critical. Measurable.

lexical_overlap_different_meaning_negati.description: High surface-word overlap but different meaning. MUST NOT cache-hit. Some safety-critical, some efficiency-only. Measurable.

policy_tenant_freshness_reuse_negative.description: Tenant/policy/freshness/reuse reference contract negatives. Identical question texts — the negative is carried by SemanticCachePayload metadata (tenant_id, written_at, embedding_model_id, reason_codes). NOT measurable for similarity; documentation anchor cross-referencing NEG-5/6/7 contract-level negatives.
